Unlock the most powerful tools with Academia Premium
Work faster and smarter with advanced research discovery tools

Search the full text and citations of our millions of papers. Download groups of related papers to jumpstart your research. Save time with detailed summaries and search alerts.

Explore tools
arrow_forward
Share your work, track your impact, and grow your audience

Get notified when other academics mention you or cite your papers. Track your impact with in-depth analytics and network with members of your field.

Grow your audience
arrow_forward
Real stories from real people
Hugh
University of California, Berkeley
If I publish in a journal, it takes 2 years to come out, and 17 people read it. If I upload to Academia, 100 people read the paper in the first week.
Wojtek
University of Business and Administration in Gdynia
The value of PDF Packs is in providing a fairly comprehensive overview of almost any topic within Academia.
Paul
Electrical Engineer
Bulk Download helps me get papers from younger scholars. It also surfaces teaching texts that assist in the development of my own hand-out materials for my students.
Robert
University of California, Berkeley
It's nice to know that one's work is being recognized around the world. Mentions can also lead to contacts with other scholars.
Steve
Clinical Psychologist
PDF Packs provide me limitless opportunities to access books and research materials which I cannot ordinarily access.
